areas.name: Poverty
areas.reason: Food insecurity and poverty among family farmers is the project's core focus; relevant component and aligned SMART indicator; impact potential judged moderate.

areas.name: Women
areas.reason: Women only prioritized as beneficiaries with sex-disaggregated data; no direct actions; indicator merges women and youth, losing specificity; limited impact.

areas.name: Indigenous and quilombola peoples
areas.reason: Traditional communities are a priority audience, but no clear share of beneficiaries, so resources and impact could not be properly estimated.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Only community fire brigades address the area, in a component of little weight; indicator does not show causality; other mechanisms unclear.

areas.name: Family farming
areas.reason: High alignment across components, notably technical assistance; relevant resources and well-built SMART indicators; impact potential moderate.

areas.name: Competitiveness
areas.reason: Value-chain objective and business-plan component relate to the area, but the share of resources directly tied is low and impact magnitude is low.

areas.name: Anti-racism
areas.reason: Quilombola communities are a target group, but no anti-racism element, component or indicator was found; minimum criteria not met.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Strong thematic alignment, but the chosen indicator mixes non-environmental aspects and its target is inconsistent and unrealistic, so impact could not be established.

areas.name: Decarbonization
areas.reason: Agro-industry support does not show a focus on technological industrialization or decarbonization; no aligned components or indicators.

areas.name: Regional equity
areas.reason: Some relevance through a vulnerable target audience, but no specific actions, resources or indicators on regional inequality.

areas.name: Transparency and participation
areas.reason: Support to councils and forums is secondary and detached from a robust strategy; no aligned indicators.

areas.name: State capacity
areas.reason: Institutional strengthening of the executing agency exists, but no indicators measure the area, so impact could not be assessed.
